recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Do not use FHIR-38871 as a broad mandate to add every Event field to every event-like resource; future work should cite specific resource trackers or mapping-exception rationale gaps.
issue_request: FHIR-38871 asked that Event-pattern resources implement common Event fields including basedOn, category, encounter, subject, and occurrence/recorded. Its Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution committed to tooling that flags missing or divergent mappings, warns when differences lack explanations, renders explanations in pattern summary flyovers, and raises work-group tracker items for follow-up.
initial_application: No explicit source commit mentioning FHIR-38871 was found. The apparent application was implicit in March 2023 source history: cc2cbce added the mappingExceptions schema, bd2e3c688 updated the Event pattern and many Event mapping-exception files, and the Jira comment then recorded that the tooling was complete and producing warnings/info messages for R5 while robust alignment would continue in R6.
additional_context: The current Event pattern is in build scope via source/hierarchy.xml and says adherence is ideal guidance rather than mandatory; deviations should have rationale understood with FHIR-I Workflow. Current source has 45 Event mapping-exception files and schema support for reasoned unmapped/divergent entries. Some R5 artifacts named in the issue have since been renamed, retired, or handled by later resource-specific decisions, so a blanket edit would be overbroad.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current specification already contains the Event pattern source and the mapping-exception inputs/tooling surface needed for the Jira resolution; any remaining resource-specific alignment should be done under targeted WG tracker items.
